svg.aria-label: F126.2 the file and the grading: the interface design of the file
svg.title: F126.2 the file and the grading: the interface design of the file

g.text: F126.2 the file and the grading: the interface design of the file

text.tspan: An eval file is three records, one inside the other, and a fact is its kind and
its one argument. The reader makes them from the file's text, and the schema is
made from the same records. The number is the step that builds each.
